title: VID-LLM: A COMPACT VIDEO-BASED 3D MULTIMODAL LLM WITH RECONSTRUCTION–REASONING SYNERGY
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and empirical evaluation of a video-based 3D Multimodal Large Language Model (Vid-LLM) for spatial reasoning and scene reconstruction. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
